text: Very flimsy, leaking after only a few uses. Super adorable and fun. But one started to leak after only a month or so of use. Wish they were a little higher quality.

product_metadata.title: Fit & Fresh, Penguins Cool Coolers Lunch Ice Packs, Set of 4, Multicolored
features: BRIGHTEN UP THEIR DAY: Set of 4 slim reusable ice packs in fun, bright colors
PERFECT SIZE: Slim size designed to use individually to fit into all types of lunch bags and boxes
MATERIALS YOU CAN TRUST: Ice packs are non-toxic, food safe and BPA-free
DIMENSIONS: Each ice pack measures 4. 75" x 3. 15" x 0. 25"
CARE TIPS: Ice packs cannot be placed in the dishwasher or microwave. Hand wash only
description: Heading back to work, school, or just need to get out of the house? These Fit + Fresh Cool Coolers Slim Ice Packs are fun shaped and perfectly sized for your lunch bags, grocery totes, coolers, picnic baskets, and more. Slim and compact, yet powerful, each ice pack measures 4.75" x 3.15" x 0.25" making them the perfect size for tight spaces or stacking together for even greater cooling power. Make sure to always have one in your freezer! Included in this set are 4 reusable ice packs that are non-toxic and BPA-Free Plastic. If the kids are headed back to school or you are planning a fun day at the park with the family, Fit + Fresh is here to help you stay healthy and safe along the way. Prevent germs from the cafeteria, shared office refrigerator, or takeout containers by packing a lunch with these long-lasting ice packs. Hand wash only, do not microwave. Proudly designed in the USA by women, for women, Fit + Fresh is dedicated to supporting your active and healthy lifestyle. We get it. Some days you eat leafy greens and rock it at the gym. Other days you can’t resist a decadent donut and live in yoga pants. We know firsthand that the key to living your best life is creating a colorful balance and we’re here with a line of accessories to help you do just that.
